title: release-train-hotfix-standup-log
content:
Release engineering weekly coordination + hotfix triage

Meeting date: 2026-03-11 09:30 PT (weekly release coordination)
Attendees: Michael Chen (owner), Aisha Patel, Diego Ramirez, Sofia Ahmed, Ravi Kapoor, on-call: Tara Lin (SRE)
Absentees: none

Purpose: sync on outgoing release train for March week 2, triage hotfix candidates, agree change-log entries and rollout strategy for feature flags and canary.

Agenda:
- Quick status on current release train (v2026.03.2)
- Hotfix queue review and severity classification
- Change-log finalization and packaging for release notes
- Canary and rollout schedule for 2026-03-12 deploy window
- Rollback criteria and automation checks
- Action items and owners

Notes / Outcomes:
1) Release train status
- Code freeze: accepted for non-critical changes as of 2026-03-10 17:00 PT. Only hotfixes or security patches until ship.
- Build artifacts: runtime images built and pushed to staging registry (registry.redwood.internal/runtime:v2026.03.2-stg). Diego verified layer diffs and size delta +2.3%.
- Integration tests: nightly full-matrix green except two flaky tests (see below).
- Docs: release-notes draft created under Confluence; requested product SME review by EOD 2026-03-12.

2) Hotfix queue (triage table from standup)
- HF-101 (REINF-4523): memory leak regression in long-lived chat sessions. Severity: P1 (customer impact on Dedicated). Root cause: KV cache invalidation timing with new batching scheduler. Assigned: Aisha. Proposed fix: revert batching heuristic + targeted test. Target: ship hotfix in v2026.03.2.1 during expedited window 2026-03-12 01:00-03:00 PT.
- HF-102 (REINF-4590): Embedding generation timeout for very long sequences when quantized model path used. Severity: P2. Assigned: Ravi. Mitigation: fallback to non-quant path for sequences > 2048 tokens. Target: roll in next patch release v2026.03.3 if not regressed by canary.
- HF-103: Spurious metric spikes in cost accounting pipeline (no customer-facing impact). Severity: P3. Assigned: Diego. Defer to post-release investigation.

Decision: HF-101 is approved for expedited hotfix. HF-102 will be monitored; mitigation gating to canary. HF-103 deferred.

3) Change-log / Release notes decisions
- Template: include summary bullets, affected subsystems (serving-runtime, routing, optimize), PR list, Jira keys, and known issues.
- Michael to draft executive summary. Aisha to add technical impact paragraph for HF-101. Product writer (Linked via Confluence comment) to finalize user-facing copy.
- Changelog items to include the following PRs: runtime PR #1827, tooling PR #329, config PR #144. (See linked_artifacts).

4) Canary & rollout plan
- Canary cohort: 5% of incoming requests routed to new runtime variant in us-west-2 for 48h. Canary routing policy: latency-first for interactive workloads, cost-first for batch.
- Monitoring hooks: latency p50/p95, error-rate, memory RSS for long-lived processes, KV cache hit-rate. Dashboard: /dashboards/release-canary-v2026.03.2.
- Automated rollback triggers:
  * sustained p95 latency increase > 20% for 30 min
  * error-rate > 1% for 15 min
  * memory growth > 15% sustained over 20 min
- Manual gate: any P1 alert requires immediate rollback until triage complete.

5) Rollback and hotfix automation notes
- Rollback automation: SRE-runbook updated to support fast switch of routing policy and model variant fallback. Tara to add a scripted rollback for canary traffic cutover (ansible playbook + k8s rollout pause).
- Artifact tagging: hotfix builds must be tagged with semantic suffix (.hotfix.<ticket>). CI will skip canary gating for emergency deploys when approved by release lead.

6) Known flaky tests and mitigation
- Test suite: test_streaming_kv_cache (intermittent) — currently flapping in staging. Repro steps logged in REINF-4601. Temporary mitigation: increase test timeout and add jitter to scheduler. Long-term: add deterministic scheduler for unit tests. Owner: Sofia.

7) Risks / Blockers
- Risk: third-party quantization library patch may introduce incompatibility with our optimized kernels; holds until we validate on a subset of models. Contingency: pin quant lib to previous stable for Dedicated tenants with strict SLAs. Owner: Diego.
- Blocker: Confluence doc approval by product writer delayed. Impact: release notes haircut for marketing. Mitigation: include minimal release notes and follow up with full update post-release.

8) Action items (concise)
- Aisha: complete HF-101 patch, run targeted long-lived chat integration tests, open PR with hotfix branch and link to REINF-4523. Due: 2026-03-11 23:00 PT.
- Ravi: implement fallback path for quantized embedding timeouts in staging; add unit tests for long sequence case. Due: 2026-03-15.
- Diego: validate quantization library on 2 representative models and document kernel mismatch checks. Due: 2026-03-13.
- Sofia: stabilize streaming KV cache test; file follow-up RFC for deterministic scheduler. Due: 2026-03-19.
- Tara (SRE): finalize canary rollback script, add alerting playbooks to on-call runbook. Due: 2026-03-12 11:00 PT.
- Michael: draft executive release notes summary and approve hotfix deployment window. Due: 2026-03-12 12:00 PT.

9) Post-release checklist (for after v2026.03.2 ship)
- Verify canary metrics stable for 48h and gradually ramp to 100% over 8 hours.
- Run smoke checks on Dedicated and Private deployments (select tenants).
- Publish final changelog and push release notes to docs.redwood.ai and product Slack channel.
- Retrospective: schedule 2026-03-19 to review hotfix handling and test flakiness. Owner: Michael.

10) Misc notes / working thoughts (informal)
- Quick note: consider adding a release train 'safety net' that automatically prevents canary from expanding when any HF with P1 tag is in the queue. This reduces accidental surface area during emergency fixes.
- TODO: update release-cal sync script to export commit SHAs per train for easier audit.
- NOTE: we saw a small regression in tokenization stemming from tokenizer-v2; low confidence but should be monitored in canary. Linked ticket: REINF-4618.

Next meeting: 2026-03-18 09:30 PT (weekly).
